definitions.explanation: An undesirable secondary effect that occurs in addition to the desired therapeutic effect of a drug or medical treatment.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}は{副作用|ふくさよう}が{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: This medicine has few side effects.

examples.japanese: {副作用|ふくさよう}として{眠気|ねむけ}が{出|で}ることがあります。
examples.english: Drowsiness may occur as a side effect.

examples.japanese: {副作用|ふくさよう}が{強|つよ}いので、{医師|いし}に{相談|そうだん}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: Since the side effects are strong, you should consult a doctor.

notes:
{副作用|ふくさよう} refers to side effects of medication or medical treatment. {副|ふく} means 'secondary/sub-' and {作用|さよう} means 'effect/action.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {副作用|ふくさよう}が{出|で}る: to experience side effects
- {副作用|ふくさよう}が{強|つよ}い: to have strong side effects
- {副作用|ふくさよう}が{少|すく}ない: to have few side effects
- {副作用|ふくさよう}のリスク: risk of side effects

COMMON SIDE EFFECTS:
- {眠気|ねむけ}: drowsiness
- {吐|は}き{気|け}: nausea
- {頭痛|ずつう}: headache
- {発疹|はっしん}: rash

RELATED WORDS:
- {薬|くすり}: medicine
- {効能|こうのう}: efficacy
- {服用|ふくよう}: taking medicine
